AuthConfig.description: Authentication configuration. Secret params may be written as `env:NAME` or `command:...`.

params.description: Handler-specific settings, such as username, token, client_id, scopes

CredentialConfig.description: Satisfies an operation credential requirement. Use either inline `auth` or `auth_ref`, not both.

auth_ref.description: Name of a top-level auth_profiles entry

satisfies.description: Scopes or roles this credential covers

items_path.description: Filter expression that extracts the items array (for example `data`). If empty, the body is used when it is an array

next_path.description: Filter expression that extracts the next-page URL from the body. Alternative to a Link header with rel="next"

page_param.description: Query parameter that increments between pages when there are no next links or next_path

ProfileConfig.description: Request defaults for an API. File-based mTLS (client_cert with client_key) cannot be combined with tls_signer.

auth_ref.description: Name of a top-level auth_profiles entry to use

base_url.description: Overrides the API-level base URL while this profile is active

ca_cert.description: Path to a PEM CA bundle for this profile

client_cert.description: Path to a PEM client certificate

client_key.description: Path to a PEM client private key

credentials.description: Maps operation credential requirement IDs to auth configurations that satisfy them

headers.description: Persistent headers sent with every request, as `Name: Value`

operation_base.description: Overrides the API-level operation base while this profile is active

query.description: Persistent query parameters sent with every request, as `key=value`

server_variables.description: Overrides API-level OpenAPI server URL variables when generating operation paths

tls_signer.description: Selects a tls-signer plugin for mTLS client certificate signing

tls_signer_params.description: Plugin-specific configuration passed to the tls-signer

url_overrides.description: Overrides or extends API-level URL prefix rewrites

description: Restish config (~/.config/restish/restish.json, %APPDATA%\restish\restish.json on Windows; also a trusted project .restish.json, which layers apis and theme). Best-effort schema from https://rest.sh/docs/reference/config/ and https://rest.sh/docs/reference/profiles/: Restish does not publish a formal schema. Unix config files must not be group- or world-readable (chmod 600).

allow_cross_origin_spec.description: Allows discovery from spec URLs in Link headers on hosts other than base_url. Private, loopback, link-local and unspecified IP literals are still rejected

allowed_operation_origins.description: Lets generated commands use operation- or path-level OpenAPI servers on origins outside base_url

base_url.description: Base URL for all requests to this API

command_layout.description: `tags` groups operations under first-tag subcommands; empty is treated as `flat`

operation_base.description: Absolute path resolved against base_url for OpenAPI operation paths

preserve_header_case.description: Sends header names with their configured casing, for HTTP/1.x servers that treat names as case-sensitive. No effect on HTTP/2

retry_max_wait.description: Caps Retry-After and X-Retry-In delays when no command-line or environment override is given

server_variables.description: Explicit values for OpenAPI server URL variables

spec_files.description: Ordered local paths or URLs, deep-merged in order with later entries winning. When set, network spec discovery is skipped and spec_url is ignored

spec_url.description: OpenAPI spec URL. spec_files wins if both are set

url_overrides.description: Rewrites resolved request URL prefixes before execution (for example to route to staging)

apis.description: Short API name to per-API configuration. Names may contain Unicode letters and numbers, combining marks, `-` and `_`, must start with a letter or number, and cannot be a built-in command (api, get, post, completion)

auth_profiles.description: Named auth configurations that profiles reference via auth_ref

cache.description: Global HTTP response cache settings (does not cover auth tokens)

plugins.description: Per-plugin config keyed by plugin name without the `restish-` prefix. Stored as raw JSON and read by plugins via the config-read message

theme.description: Syntax-highlighting overrides. Keys are Chroma token names or Restish aliases (text, header_key, heading, diagnostic_warn, diagnostic_error, diagnostic_hint, status_2xx); values are Chroma style descriptors

theme_source.description: Source last used by `config theme set`. Local paths are absolute; official themes are `official:<name>`
